items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Well, that I really don't know. Well, you see, they had all gone by the time I got there.

ctx.x: But Maxine is given as the cause for other people leaving the band too. I think -- let's see, who was there before Charlie Shavers? Was it --
Frankie Newton. It was said that he left because of something over Maxine, some problem.
